checks.name: isolated installation of two real AGH instances
real session login and independent Bearer Token authentication
two nodes online with versions and heartbeats
cluster settings update through authenticated management API
master 7-day and member 24-hour retention use the common window
custom filtering rules and DNS configuration synchronize to the member
statistics are exact sums with a common series window
query logs merge with source-node annotations
cluster membership and synchronized configuration survive restart
member becomes degraded after repeated health failures
offline reads return partial aggregate results and structured errors
recovery triggers alignment and clears pending synchronization
audit records operations without tokens, rule bodies, or request bodies
member unregistration through the real management API
